desc: Statement of deviation(s) or variation(s) under Reg. 32
voiceSummary: Lalithaa Jewellery Mart Limited filed a statement of deviation for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, confirming no material deviation in the utilization of Initial Public Offer proceeds. The company raised Rs. 12,000 million through an IPO priced at Rs. 201 per share, with fresh issue proceeds of Rs. 12,000 million and offer for sale proceeds of Rs. 5,000 million. The shares were listed on August 24, 2026. As of the end of the quarter, Rs. 7,503.26 million was utilized against an allocation of Rs. 12,000 million. Utilization included Rs. 125 million for capital expenditure on ten new stores, Rs. 5,854.78 million for inventory costs for new stores, Rs. 845.20 million for general corporate purposes, and Rs. 678.29 million for IPO issue expenses. The unutilized balance of Rs. 4,496.74 million was temporarily invested in bank accounts, deposits, bonds, and commercial paper. CARE Ratings Limited serves as the monitoring agency.

Lalithaa Jewellery Mart Limited filed the Monitoring Agency Report for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, issued by CARE Ratings Limited. The report concerns the utilization of Rs. 1,200 crore raised through the Initial Public Offer. The company utilized Rs. 750.33 crore, leaving Rs. 449.67 crore unutilized. Funds were deployed in State Bank of India fixed deposits and current accounts. The monitoring agency noted co-mingling of funds in current accounts. There were no deviations from the objects of the issue. The report was reviewed by the Audit Committee and Board of Directors on November 11, 2026.

attchmntText: Lalithaa Jewellery Mart Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Lalithaa Jewellery Mart Limited approved its standalone and consolidated unaudited financial results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. The Board recommended the appointment of M/s. V. S. Sowrirajan & Associates as Secretarial Auditors for five consecutive financial years from FY 2026-27 to FY 2030-31, subject to shareholder approval at the ensuing Annual General Meeting. The Board also approved amendments to the Code of Conduct for the prevention of insider trading. Additionally, the Board approved a draft scheme of amalgamation for the merger of wholly-owned subsidiaries Centigrade Apparels Private Limited and Asita Jewellery Manufacturing Private Limited with Lalithaa Jewellery Mart Limited. This merger is subject to requisite statutory and regulatory approvals, including those from the National Company Law Tribunal, shareholders, and creditors. No shares are proposed to be issued, and there will be no change in the shareholding pattern.
